verdict.rationale: SumUp's Cloud API is a documented server-driven integration. A POS on any platform that can send HTTPS requests can start and manage transactions that complete on a Solo or Go reader. It also supports multiple readers, remote sending with no distance limit, and a Virtual Solo for testing, and an OpenAPI spec is published. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the Cloud API terminal flow, and documented status callbacks for terminal transactions (the webhooks doc covers only checkout status changes).

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a custom point-of-sale checkout that drives the terminal from my backend through a documented server-driven API

citations.quote: The Cloud API lets you start a transaction from a Point of Sale (POS) running on any platform (Windows, iOS, Linux, Android, Web-based, etc.) capable of sending HTTPS requests and complete that transaction via a Solo reader.
Trigger and manage payments on Solo or Go readers via HTTPS requests.
No distance limitation between your POS device and the Solo card reader; transactions can be sent remotely
Virtual Solo simulates a Solo card reader so you can test pairing and checkout flows.
